🔹 What’s going on?  
• The Trello MCP server tries to start by running `tsx supporting-systems/trello-integration/index.ts`.  
• On launch it immediately imports `dotenv`.  
• `dotenv` (and the rest of the node-modules folder) isn’t installed locally → Node throws `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, so the server crashes before it can register any tools. Cursor then shows “0 tools enabled” with the red dot.

🔹 Quick fix  
1. From the repo root run:  
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```  
   (or `pnpm install` / `yarn` – whichever you use).  
2. Toggle the Trello server back on; it should now load, list its tools, and the red dot will disappear.

🔹 Why it happened  
• The old `node_modules_OLD_…` folder in `archive/` suggests dependencies were blown away during a cleanup or move.  
• The MCP UI relies on the process exiting cleanly; any missing package will silently break the connection.

Try the install and let me know if anything else pops up. 🤖
